messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT at 1769999999 - sudden spike in 5xxs for inference-api in us-west-2. ELB target-group tg-inference-usw2b showing >40% unhealthy, Route53 latency increases and multiple ENI detach events reported in CloudWatch. Metrics: https://metrics.internal/redwood/usw2/inference (auto-alert)

Maria G: I'm looking now. Paging oncall.

oncall-sre: I'm oncall, joining the channel. Can you confirm scope? Is it single AZ or region-wide?

Raj P: seeing concentrated 504/502 from clients hitting lb-usw2b. CloudTrail shows ENI detach/re-attach events for eni-0a1b2c3d in us-west-2b across multiple instances.

Eli S: grepping app logs shows a lot of connection resets and short-lived TCP closes around the same timestamps. Suspect data-plane ENI instability rather than app bug.

Sofia L: Any Route53 logs? Could be DNS-based oscillation causing rapid weight shifts.

Incident Bot: Health-check flip detected: targetgroup tg-inference-usw2b -> draining (35 targets draining). Auto-failover policy initiated: weight rebalancing started.

oncall-sre: Starting manual mitigation now: 1) exclude us-west-2b from ELB AZ balancing 2) set connection draining to 30s 3) increase capacity in 2a/2c. Running command:
```
aws elbv2 modify-load-balancer-attributes --load-balancer-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:123456:loadbalancer/app/inference-lb/abcd --attributes Key=idle_timeout.timeout_seconds,Value=60
aws elbv2 set-subnets --load-balancer-arn <arn> --subnets subnet-2a subnet-2c
```

Raj P: Route53 TTL is 60s. We can adjust weighted routing to steer traffic away from 2b quickly. I'll prepare the change but want to avoid oscillation.

Maria G: Drafting status page message: "Partial degradation in US-WEST-2 affecting inference requests; mitigation underway."

Eli S: Correlating with EBS metrics - some instances in 2b show elevated i/o latency and ioerrors around the same start time. Opening AWS SR with instance IDs and NIC events.

AWS Support Bot: Support case created: SR# 123456789 - Investigating ENI detaches and EBS IO errors in us-west-2b. Putting AWS contacts on the thread.

oncall-sre: Executing Route53 weighted update to reduce us-west-2b to 0 weight, split 90/10 between 2a/2c. Command used:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123456 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.internal","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-west-2a","Weight":90,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"34.201.1.2"}]} ,{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.internal","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-west-2c","Weight":10,"TTL":60,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"34.201.3.4"}]}}]}'
```

Raj P: Noted. Some customers on Dedicated pools still show elevated latency — looks like cached connections to 2b kept open from upstream proxies. Working on draining and warming other AZs.

Maria G: Suggest enabling degraded-mode throttling for non-critical endpoints (logs/analytics) to reduce load while we recover.

Eli S: Starting ASG rolling replace for instances in 2b to avoid risky reattach loops. Replacing 6 instances one-by-one. Script snippet:
```
for id in $(aws ec2 describe-instances --filters "Name=tag:asg,Values=inference-asg-usw2b" --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].InstanceId' --output text); do
  aws autoscaling terminate-instance-in-auto-scaling-group --instance-id $id --should-decrement-desired-capacity
  sleep 30
done
```

Incident Bot: Automation note: auto-replace attempted for 3 instances; two succeeded, one reattach loop detected.

Sofia L: Notifying sales/customers with reserved capacity in region. Creating a customer-impact thread with account names and SLA implications.

oncall-sre: Handoff plan: I'll run mitigation for the next 30m then hand to Raj for follow-up and postmortem. Setting incident priority to P1 due to partial regional impact and customer latency.

Raj P: ACK. Taking over at T+30.

Maria G: AWS support acknowledged a regional networking degradation affecting ENI attachment stability and EBS backend IO. They are running a fabric health check. AWS assigned an internal escalation.

Incident Bot: Flagging this incident for postmortem: tags -> [ENI-saturation, route53-oscillation, P1]. Add runbook: networking-az-failover.

oncall-sre: After exclusions and ASG replacements, 5xx rates back to baseline for most customers. Will keep monitoring 15m before closing.

Maria G: TL;DR for handoff: excluded us-west-2b from ELB, updated Route53 weights, replaced ASG instances in 2b, opened SR#123456789 with AWS, notified customers, and preparing postmortem. :white_check_mark:

Raj P: I'll capture timeline, metrics, command history, and AWS correspondence for the PM. Assigning action items: runbook updates (Eli), customer comms follow-up (Maria), infra automation check for ENI flapping (Sofia).

Maria G: Handing off final notes and closing channel for active mitigation. Will reopen if AWS reports additional events. Thanks team.
